summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ARK DIET Q1 Buffer ETF (ARKD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is actively managed and seeks to deliver a defined outcome linked to the ARK Disruptive Innovation ETF (ARKK). The fund aims to absorb roughly half of ARKKs downside while capturing gains above a 5% hurdle, over a 12-month period starting each January. ARKD was launched on Jan 2, 2026 and is issued by ARK.
